_why: Silhouettes that PASS every automatic gate in tools/refsil.py and are
still wrong, refused by hand after looking at the overlay.
THIS FILE EXISTS BECAUSE THE AUTOMATIC GATE CANNOT DETECT A SITTING
ANIMAL, and that limit was established by trying. A sitting mustelid has
a belly line, two or more runs across the leg band, a plausible
height/length and a plausible thickness/length -- because the haunch it
is sitting on measures exactly like a very thick leg. Four separate
discriminators were built and tested against the corpus and all four
failed:
limb thickness over BODY length   fisher 0.159 sits inside the range of
real stocky animals; our own pika
measures 0.182 standing.
ground contact width              fisher does not even reach the top 14;
elephants and rhinos rank above it
because they genuinely have big feet.
cross-silhouette agreement        fisher's two references agree with each
other to 21% -- both artists drew the
same sitting pose, so more samples and
a tighter spread gate never help.
within-silhouette leg disagreement  2.48 and 1.00, against a corpus
median of 1.66 and a 75th percentile of
2.41. No threshold separates it.
So the defence is not a cleverer gate. It is (a) this list, written only
after looking at the overlay, and (b) MAX_LIFT in tools/reffit.py, which
bounds what any single undetected bad reference can do to a spec.

excluded.fisher/5e13bb38.png: sitting: hind quarters on the ground, tail along the floor. The haunch tracks as a limb and reads 0.537 thick for its length.
excluded.fisher/622e05d2.png: sitting, same pose. Only one limb tracks; the measurement is of a foreleg against a seated belly height.
excluded.european-hare/4afd156c.png: sitting up on the haunches; the hind limb is folded, not standing.
excluded.european-rabbit/d71fcd12.png: crouched, hocks on the ground; belly height is not leg length.
excluded.raccoon/047f311e.png: crouched with all four feet gathered; 0.94 of the body length is in ground contact.
excluded.brown-bear/c7fbe213.png: rearing; the forelimbs are off the ground entirely.
